NBA DFS Rankings for Saturday, October 24 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Saturday, October 24 · 5 games · First game 7:30 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 24, 5:50 PM ET

Victor Wembanyama (SAS) ranks first on the Saturday, October 24 DraftKings main slate at 57.3 projected DraftKings points for $10,700. Anthony Davis (WAS, 47.0) and Joel Embiid (PHI, 46.7) are next.

The table ranks all 74 players in the run by SPAGS projection, with DraftKings salary and projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 24, 5:50 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.
